scope: Self-contained illustrative website demo; no inference requests.
rigid: Original RBO and PartNet assets, native workbench keypoints, FK and joint limits.
skinned: Cached workbench SDF zero surfaces with simplified display geometry. Browser bone weights approximate transport of these cached surfaces; they are not fresh model predictions.
occupancy: Surface-band point samples of the same displayed geometry.
sdf: Zero-isosurface display; optional normals from current displayed triangles.
constraints: Copied workbench projection descriptor and bounded local solver.
xhand: Native XHand right URDF/STL meshes, 12 joint limits, surface handles and bounded finger-chain inverse kinematics.
